verses.1: My son, by my wisdom, listen to my words; your ears should be attentive.
verses.2: Be careful to keep your words and thoughts in check.
verses.3: For those who are foreign to God’s ways, their lips will be closed, and part of their breath will be held back.
verses.4: And after that, it became like a burning fire, as if it were a terrible disaster.
verses.5: Her feet descend from death; her steps are still moving forward.
verses.6: Let them live in peace; let them not be destroyed by their own mistakes. You will not know what will happen.
verses.7: And now, sons, listen to me. Do not ignore what I say.
verses.8: Stay away from her. Do not approach the door of her house.
verses.9: Do not give your honor and your love to the wicked.
verses.10: May the foreigners praise your strength and your beauty in a foreign land.
verses.11: And you will die in your later years, with your tongue and your remaining body also.
verses.12: And you said, “How I love Musar… Please let my heart be at peace.”
verses.13: And I did not hear the voice of the Lord; I did not pay attention to His teachings.
verses.14: Although I was in all kinds of trouble among a crowd and a council.
verses.15: Fill your vessels with water, and let them be filled with water throughout your journey.
verses.16: They will be freed from your bonds; they will be released into the vast depths of the oceans.
verses.17: It shall be yours alone; no one else shall have it.
verses.18: May your life be filled with blessings and joy, from the love of your bride.
verses.19: May love and kindness always be upon her, and may she be blessed in every moment through her love.
verses.20: And why should my son be disgraced among strangers, and violate the laws of a foreign people?
verses.21: For the eyes of the LORD are upon people’s paths and all their movements.
verses.22: May his enemies be captured by him, and may they be punished for their sins.
verses.23: He died without being remembered, and his memory was lost forever.
